assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries.
The patient has sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries.
The patient has syncope and presyncope.
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or ischemic changes.
The evaluation addresses the distinct clinical need to correlate events with arrhythmias.
The service is not bundled into other covered procedures.
